verdicts.reason: The two layouts are identical except for the logo. Both share the same flaws: the can sits left of centre (about x=118 on a 300px canvas) while the headline and CTA are centred, the large decorative circle crowds the can, the CTA is jammed close to the bottom edge, and the logo is squeezed into the top-right corner beside the NEW FLAVOR pill instead of being centred as in the original. A keeps the sun mark and SOLSTICE wordmark at a legible size. In B the logo has shrunk to a tiny, illegible mark, so the brand is effectively lost.
